FactorWeight.description: One weighted factor in a score/watch stage.
FactorWeight.title: FactorWeight

FilterCondition.description:
A single boolean filter: ``{op: gt, left: close, right: 10}``.

``left`` is a column name string or an Operand dict.
``right`` is a literal, a column name (with ``right_kind: col``), or an Operand dict.
``expr`` is an optional human-readable formula string.
``id`` is a stable chip identity for agent patch ops.
``annotation`` is UI/agent provenance (stripped before SQL WHERE).
FilterCondition.title: FilterCondition

FilterGroup.description: A boolean group (AND / OR) of filter conditions and/or sub-groups.
FilterGroup.title: FilterGroup

FilterNot.description:
A negated filter subtree, in the document's own terms.

The compiled where-AST has always been able to express `not`, but the document model
could only hold one negated shape — `neq`, i.e. `not(eq(...))`. Every other `not` was
silently rewritten as a *positive* AND of its child, so "not above the 50-day" loaded
back as "above the 50-day": the negation inverted. This node keeps it explicit.
FilterNot.title: FilterNot

HedgeConfig.description: Portfolio hedge configuration during risk-off regimes.
HedgeConfig.title: HedgeConfig

ModelRef.description:
An explicit LEAN model reference — the flexible-slot primitive.

Any slot (Universe / Alpha / PortfolioConstruction / RiskManagement /
Execution) can be filled either by a *named concept* (compiled to a known
LEAN class) or by a raw ``ModelRef`` naming *any* LEAN class — including new
ones we author — with its ``parameters`` passed through verbatim.
ModelRef.title: ModelRef

PipelineBindings.description:
Named slot expressions compiled onto Alpha / PCM / Risk Parameters.

Authored here (with stages); never persisted as a whole-strategy
``VeraBase.Pipeline`` blob (C-STRATEGY-PIPELINE-SSOT).

alpha_rank_directions.description: Optional ASC/DESC per alpha_rank field (default desc).
alpha_rank_directions.title: Alpha Rank Directions

PipelineBindings.title: PipelineBindings

PolicyOverride.description:
Conditional knob override: when bool chips match, set allowlisted PCM/Risk params.

Applied in chain order at runtime (last-wins per param). Knobs on sizing/exit
stages remain defaults.
PolicyOverride.title: PolicyOverride

PolicyRule.description: One policy-rule chain link: role + SlotExpr payload (Studio SSOT).
PolicyRule.title: PolicyRule

PyramidPhase.description: One phase of progressive position scaling (test -> add -> full).
PyramidPhase.title: PyramidPhase

RegimeGateV1.description:
Declarative regime score + optional slot uses (C-REGIME-POLICY-V1).

Score/hysteresis remain the continuous market condition. ``uses`` lists which
Lean slots subscribe — presence of a regime source alone is not an Alpha valve.

uses.description: Slot subscriptions: scale_exposure, skip_pyramid_adds, block_new_longs, hedge
uses.title: Uses

RegimeGateV1.title: RegimeGateV1

SlotExpr.description:
Bool or number expression over the Alpha computed + L7 column bag.

Bool slots use the same ``vera_bool_expr`` / where AST as stage filters.
Number slots use Operand / formula AST (``col`` / ``lit`` / ``formula``).
``__position.*`` cols are runtime-only (Risk); not probeable.
SlotExpr.title: SlotExpr

computed_expr.description: Number Operand AST for Universe.computed[] (kind=number, expr=…). Authors aggregate measure aliases / L7 cols; not a gate bool.

id.description: Stable binding id (screen_1, setup_pass). Defaults to slug of name.

init_stop.description: Initial-stop Operand AST (C-VERA-EXPR-V2): exit-stage value compiles to RiskManagement.Parameters.init_stop.

measure_filter.description: Optional exclude-if filter on this measure alias → Universe.post_where. Independent of Insight ✓ / ORDER BY.

rules.description: Ordered rule-driven control flow (C-FW-RULES): alpha stages carry their entries in Alpha.Parameters.stages; exit-stage rules compile to RiskManagement.Parameters.rules.

signal_weight.description: Weight for count_as_signal gates in screens_hit_w (unweighted screens_hit stays Σ 1).

max_stop_loss_pct.description: Cap on ATR stop distance as fraction of entry (e.g. 0.05 = 5%)
max_stop_loss_pct.title: Max Stop Loss Pct

UniverseConfig.title: UniverseConfig

regime_gate.description: Cross-slot regime policy → VeraBase.DataSources.regime + uses[] routed to PCM/Alpha. Preferred home; risk.regime_gate is the deprecated pre-migration location.
regime_gate.title: Regime Gate

pipeline_document_schema.title: PipelineDocument

ComputedSelect.description:
Named measure compiled into the SELECT list (C-UNIVERSE-QUERY-V1).

Bool measures become ``toUInt8(<predicate>) AS alias``. Number measures use
``expr``, ``mean_available``, or ``sum_aliases`` (count combinator over prior
bool aliases). Later computed items may ``col``-ref earlier aliases (same
SELECT left-to-right reuse in ClickHouse).
ComputedSelect.title: ComputedSelect

FormulaExpr.description: Binary arithmetic formula operand; nests via ``args`` (C-VERA-EXPR).
FormulaExpr.title: FormulaExpr

OrderByItem.description:
Single ORDER BY term: either an allowlisted ``field`` (must be in select)
or a computed ``expr`` operand (ColRef / LitVal / FormulaExpr over allowlisted
columns). Exactly one of ``field`` / ``expr`` must be present.
OrderByItem.title: OrderByItem

UniverseJoin.description: Specification of a joined satellite table in a universe query.
UniverseJoin.title: UniverseJoin

from.description: Legacy logical source alias (optional; 'screener' or 'daily_screener'). Ignored in favor of spine/joins.
from.title: From

joins.description: Auto-resolved or explicit satellite table joins onto the spine.
joins.title: Joins

post_where.description: Optional filter on SELECT/computed output aliases (e.g. screens_hit >= 2). Compiled as an outer WHERE around the inner projection so aliases are visible.
post_where.title: Post Where

spine.description: Physical spine table for universe queries (default: screener_price_tech_daily).
spine.title: Spine

where.description: JSON boolean expression tree (preferred). Mutually exclusive with where_sql.
where.title: Where

where_sql.description: Optional ClickHouse-style predicate string (parsed with sqlglot, a core dependency). Mutually exclusive with where. Same allowlisted columns as JSON `col` refs.
where_sql.title: Where Sql
